```{python}
#| label: explorer-payload
#| output: asis
import json
from src.reports.explorer import build_explorer_payload
# The including report may set `explorer_collection` / `explorer_games` to
# scope the table (e.g. the menu report). Fall back to the full `data` bundle.
_ec = explorer_collection if "explorer_collection" in dir() else data.collection
_eg = explorer_games if "explorer_games" in dir() else data.games
_payload = build_explorer_payload(_ec, _eg)
print(
    '<script id="explorer-data" type="application/json">'
    + json.dumps(_payload)
    + "</script>"
)
```

```{=html}

  <summary class="explorer-controls-title">Filters</summary>
  <div id="explorer-filters" class="explorer-filters"></div>
  <div id="explorer-controls-footer" class="explorer-controls-footer"></div>
</details>
```

```{=html}

  <span id="explorer-count"></span>
  <span class="pc-key">
    <span class="pc-badge pc-best">n</span> best
    <span class="pc-badge pc-rec">n</span> recommended

  </span>
</div>
```

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  function ready(fn){ if(document.readyState!=='loading') fn(); else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn); }
  ready(function () {
    var el = document.getElementById('explorer-data');
    var mount = document.getElementById('explorer-mount');
    if(!el || !mount) return;
    var payload;
    try { payload = JSON.parse(el.textContent); } catch(e) { return; }
    var COLS = payload.columns || [];
    var ROWS = payload.rows || [];
    if(!ROWS.length){ mount.innerHTML = '<p class="explorer-empty">No games to show.</p>'; return; }

    // ---- helpers ----
    function isNumericStr(s){ return s !== '' && s != null && !isNaN(parseFloat(s)) && isFinite(s.toString().replace(/[^0-9.\-]/g,'')) ; }
    // parse "60–120 min", "30 min", "9.0", "" -> {lo,hi} or null
    function parseRange(txt){
      if(txt === '' || txt == null) return null;
      var cleaned = String(txt).replace(/[^0-9.\-–]/g,'');
      var parts = cleaned.split(/[–-]/).filter(function(s){return s!=='';});
      if(!parts.length) return null;
      var lo = parseFloat(parts[0]); var hi = parts.length>1 ? parseFloat(parts[1]) : lo;
      if(isNaN(lo)) return null;
      return {lo: lo, hi: isNaN(hi)?lo:hi};
    }
    // tokens of a multi cell "2, 3, 4" -> ["2","3","4"]
    function tokens(txt){
      if(txt === '' || txt == null) return [];
      return String(txt).split(',').map(function(s){return s.trim();}).filter(function(s){return s!=='';});
    }
    function sortVals(vals){
      var allNum = vals.every(function(v){ return v!=='' && !isNaN(parseFloat(v)); });
      var out = vals.slice();
      if(allNum) out.sort(function(a,b){ return parseFloat(a)-parseFloat(b); });
      else out.sort();
      return out;
    }

    // ---- filter state ----
    // discrete/multi: Set of active values per column index; range: {min,max}
    function initState(c){
      if(c.kind==='discrete'||c.kind==='multi'||c.kind==='range-contains') return {active:new Set()};
      if(c.kind==='badges') return {active:new Set(), basis:'best'};
      if(c.kind==='range') return {min:'', max:''};
      return null;
    }
    var state = COLS.map(initState);
    var sortIdx = -1, sortDir = 1;
    var pageSize = 25, page = 0;

    function rowMatches(row){
      for(var i=0;i<COLS.length;i++){
        var c = COLS[i], st = state[i], cell = row[i];
        if(c.kind==='discrete'){
          if(st.active.size && !st.active.has(String(cell))) return false;
        } else if(c.kind==='multi'){
          if(st.active.size){
            var t = tokens(cell); var hit=false;
            st.active.forEach(function(v){ if(t.indexOf(v)>=0) hit=true; });
            if(!hit) return false;
          }
        } else if(c.kind==='range-contains'){
          if(st.active.size){
            var rr = parseRange(cell);
            if(rr){
              var any=false;
              st.active.forEach(function(v){
                // "8+" chip matches when the supported max reaches 8+
                if(v==='8+'){ if(rr.hi>=8) any=true; }
                else { var n=parseFloat(v); if(rr.lo<=n && n<=rr.hi) any=true; }
              });
              if(!any) return false;
            } // unknown range -> keep
          }
        } else if(c.kind==='badges'){
          if(st.active.size){
            var set = (st.basis==='best') ? (cell&&cell.best||[]) : (cell&&cell.rec||[]);
            var hit=false;
            st.active.forEach(function(v){ if(set.indexOf(parseInt(v,10))>=0) hit=true; });
            if(!hit) return false;
          }
        } else if(c.kind==='range'){
          if(st.min!==''||st.max!==''){
            var r = parseRange(cell);
            if(r){
              var lo = st.min===''? -Infinity : parseFloat(st.min);
              var hi = st.max===''?  Infinity : parseFloat(st.max);
              // containment: the game's whole range must fit within [lo,hi]
              if(!(r.lo>=lo && r.hi<=hi)) return false;
            } // unknown -> keep
          }
        }
      }
      return true;
    }

    // ---- build filter controls ----
    var filtersEl = document.getElementById('explorer-filters');
    function buildFilters(){
      filtersEl.innerHTML = '';
      COLS.forEach(function(c, i){
        if(c.kind==='none') return;
        var group = document.createElement('div');
        group.className = 'facet';
        var lab = document.createElement('div'); lab.className='facet-label'; lab.textContent=c.label;
        group.appendChild(lab);
        if(c.kind==='discrete'||c.kind==='multi'||c.kind==='range-contains'){
          var chipVals;
          if(c.kind==='range-contains'){
            chipVals = ['1','2','3','4','5','6','7','8','8+'];
          } else {
            var vals = new Set();
            ROWS.forEach(function(r){
              if(c.kind==='discrete'){ if(r[i]!=='' && r[i]!=null) vals.add(String(r[i])); }
              else tokens(r[i]).forEach(function(t){ vals.add(t); });
            });
            chipVals = sortVals(Array.from(vals));
          }
          var wrap = document.createElement('div'); wrap.className='chips';
          chipVals.forEach(function(v){
            var chip = document.createElement('button');
            chip.type='button'; chip.className='chip'; chip.textContent=v;
            chip.addEventListener('click', function(){
              if(state[i].active.has(v)){ state[i].active.delete(v); chip.classList.remove('active'); }
              else { state[i].active.add(v); chip.classList.add('active'); }
              page=0; render();
            });
            wrap.appendChild(chip);
          });
          group.appendChild(wrap);
        } else if(c.kind==='badges'){
          // Best | Recommended basis toggle
          var toggle = document.createElement('div'); toggle.className='basis-toggle';
          [['best','Best'],['rec','Recommended']].forEach(function(pair){
            var b = document.createElement('button');
            b.type='button'; b.className='basis-btn'+(state[i].basis===pair[0]?' active':'');
            b.textContent=pair[1];
            b.addEventListener('click', function(){
              state[i].basis=pair[0];
              toggle.querySelectorAll('.basis-btn').forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove('active');});
              b.classList.add('active');
              page=0; render();
            });
            toggle.appendChild(b);
          });
          group.appendChild(toggle);
          var bwrap = document.createElement('div'); bwrap.className='chips';
          ['1','2','3','4','5','6','7','8'].forEach(function(v){
            var chip = document.createElement('button');
            chip.type='button'; chip.className='chip'; chip.textContent=v;
            chip.addEventListener('click', function(){
              if(state[i].active.has(v)){ state[i].active.delete(v); chip.classList.remove('active'); }
              else { state[i].active.add(v); chip.classList.add('active'); }
              page=0; render();
            });
            bwrap.appendChild(chip);
          });
          group.appendChild(bwrap);
        } else if(c.kind==='range'){
          var rw = document.createElement('div'); rw.className='explorer-range';
          ['min','max'].forEach(function(b){
            var inp = document.createElement('input');
            inp.type='number'; inp.step='any'; inp.placeholder=b;
            inp.addEventListener('input', function(){ state[i][b]=inp.value; page=0; render(); });
            rw.appendChild(inp);
          });
          group.appendChild(rw);
        }
        filtersEl.appendChild(group);
      });
      var footer = document.getElementById('explorer-controls-footer');
      if(footer){
        footer.innerHTML = '';
        var reset = document.createElement('button');
        reset.type='button'; reset.className='chip reset'; reset.textContent='Reset';
        reset.addEventListener('click', function(){
          state = COLS.map(initState);
          page=0; buildFilters(); render();
        });
        footer.appendChild(reset);
      }
    }

    // ---- page-size selector ----
    function buildPageSize(){
      var host = document.getElementById('explorer-pagesize');
      if(!host) return;
      host.innerHTML = '';
      var lab = document.createElement('span'); lab.className='pagesize-label'; lab.textContent='Show ';
      var sel = document.createElement('select'); sel.className='pagesize-select';
      [25,50,100,'All'].forEach(function(opt){
        var o = document.createElement('option');
        o.value = (opt==='All') ? '0' : String(opt);
        o.textContent = opt; sel.appendChild(o);
      });
      sel.value = String(pageSize);
      sel.addEventListener('change', function(){ pageSize = parseInt(sel.value,10)||0; page=0; render(); });
      host.appendChild(lab); host.appendChild(sel);
    }

    // ---- cell helpers ----
    function badgeHtml(cell){
      if(!cell || !cell.rec || !cell.rec.length) return '<span class="badge-none">—</span>';
      var best = cell.best || [];
      return cell.rec.map(function(n){
        var isBest = best.indexOf(n)>=0;
        return '<span class="pc-badge'+(isBest?' pc-best':' pc-rec')+'" title="'
          + (isBest?'Best at '+n:'Recommended at '+n)+'">'+n+'</span>';
      }).join('');
    }
    // complexity diverging blue→white→orange, anchored to the range that
    // actually occurs for games with >=25 ratings (~1.0 .. 4.5, mid 2.75).
    var WMIN=1.0, WMID=2.75, WMAX=4.5;
    var W_LOW=[59,130,246], W_MIDC=[241,243,246], W_HIGH=[234,120,40]; // blue, near-white, orange
    function mix(a,b,t){ return [Math.round(a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*t),Math.round(a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*t),Math.round(a[2]+(b[2]-a[2])*t)]; }
    function weightBadge(val){
      var w = parseFloat(val);
      if(isNaN(w)) return '<span class="badge-none">—</span>';
      var wc, ink;
      if(w<=WMID){ var t=Math.max(0,(w-WMIN)/(WMID-WMIN)); wc=mix(W_LOW,W_MIDC,t); }
      else { var t2=Math.min(1,(w-WMID)/(WMAX-WMID)); wc=mix(W_MIDC,W_HIGH,t2); }
      // dark ink on the pale middle, white ink on the saturated ends
      var lum=(wc[0]*0.299+wc[1]*0.587+wc[2]*0.114);
      ink = lum>170 ? '#1e222b' : '#fff';
      return '<span class="weight-badge" style="--wc:rgb('+wc[0]+' '+wc[1]+' '+wc[2]+');--wi:'+ink+';">'
        + w.toFixed(2) + '</span>';
    }
    function sortKey(cell){
      // badges object -> sort by lowest best (then lowest rec)
      if(cell && typeof cell==='object'){
        var arr = (cell.best&&cell.best.length)?cell.best:(cell.rec||[]);
        return arr.length ? arr[0] : Infinity;
      }
      var n = parseFloat(String(cell).replace(/[^0-9.\-]/g,''));
      return isNaN(n) ? null : n;
    }
    // Plain text for lexical sort: strip HTML tags (e.g. the Game column's
    // <a> link) so we compare the visible name, not the markup.
    function sortText(cell){
      if(cell && typeof cell==='object') return '';
      return String(cell).replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '').trim().toLowerCase();
    }

    // ---- render table ----
    function render(){
      var filtered = ROWS.filter(rowMatches);
      if(sortIdx>=0){
        filtered = filtered.slice().sort(function(a,b){
          var ak=sortKey(a[sortIdx]), bk=sortKey(b[sortIdx]);
          if(ak!==null && bk!==null) return (ak-bk)*sortDir;
          return sortText(a[sortIdx]).localeCompare(sortText(b[sortIdx]))*sortDir;
        });
      }
      var total = filtered.length;
      var size = pageSize>0 ? pageSize : total;
      var pageCount = size>0 ? Math.ceil(total/size) : 1;
      if(page > pageCount-1) page = Math.max(0, pageCount-1);
      var start = pageSize>0 ? page*size : 0;
      var end = pageSize>0 ? Math.min(start+size, total) : total;
      var pageRows = filtered.slice(start, end);

      var html = '<table id="explorer-tbl" class="explorer-table"><thead><tr>';
      COLS.forEach(function(c, i){
        var arrow = sortIdx===i ? (sortDir>0?' ▲':' ▼') : '';
        html += '<th data-i="'+i+'">'+c.label+arrow+'</th>';
      });
      html += '</tr></thead><tbody>';
      pageRows.forEach(function(r){
        html += '<tr>';
        COLS.forEach(function(c, i){
          if(c.kind==='badges'){
            html += '<td class="dt-center pc-cell">'+badgeHtml(r[i])+'</td>';
          } else if(c.label==='Complexity'){
            html += '<td class="dt-center">'+weightBadge(r[i])+'</td>';
          } else {
            var cls = (c.label==='Game') ? '' : ' class="dt-center"';
            html += '<td'+cls+'>'+(r[i]==null?'':r[i])+'</td>';
          }
        });
        html += '</tr>';
      });
      html += '</tbody></table>';
      mount.innerHTML = html;

      var cnt = document.getElementById('explorer-count');
      if(cnt){
        cnt.textContent = total===0 ? 'No games match'
          : 'Showing ' + (start+1) + '–' + end + ' of ' + total
            + (total!==ROWS.length ? ' (filtered from ' + ROWS.length + ')' : '') + ' games';
      }

      var pager = document.getElementById('explorer-pager');
      if(pager){
        pager.innerHTML = '';
        if(pageSize>0 && pageCount>1){
          var prev = document.createElement('button');
          prev.type='button'; prev.className='chip'; prev.textContent='‹ Prev';
          prev.disabled = page<=0;
          prev.addEventListener('click', function(){ if(page>0){ page--; render(); } });
          var info = document.createElement('span');
          info.className='pager-info'; info.textContent='Page ' + (page+1) + ' of ' + pageCount;
          var next = document.createElement('button');
          next.type='button'; next.className='chip'; next.textContent='Next ›';
          next.disabled = page>=pageCount-1;
          next.addEventListener('click', function(){ if(page<pageCount-1){ page++; render(); } });
          pager.appendChild(prev); pager.appendChild(info); pager.appendChild(next);
        }
      }

      mount.querySelectorAll('th').forEach(function(th){
        th.addEventListener('click', function(){
          var i = parseInt(th.dataset.i,10);
          if(sortIdx===i) sortDir = -sortDir; else { sortIdx=i; sortDir=1; }
          page=0; render();
        });
      });
    }

    buildFilters();
    buildPageSize();
    render();
  });
})();
</script>
```
